glow_phase_case.lead_question: what does composite Glow refuse, why, and is it a junk-capture bound
glow_phase_case.refusal: crates/hsk-studio-composite/src/temporal/composition/effects.rs:634 (before this lane: an exact equality of Color Phase with GLOW_PHASE_DEFAULT, then self.refused(), code composition_effect_option = COMPOSITION_EFFECT_OPTION); GLOW_PHASE_DEFAULT = 0.003906 at :120; is_default_glow_phase at :126
glow_phase_case.is_junk_range: no. It is not the 0.003906..0.496094 hard range or any range: it is a not-implemented refusal whose reference value is the recorded default, which SD-26 marks provisional/UNVERIFIED, so the comparison point itself may be wrong
glow_phase_case.spec_case_applied: the spec does NOT state Color Phase semantics. Module 14 v02.229 (.GOV/spec/master-spec-v02.229/spec-modules/14-studio-creative-suite.md): the only Color Phase text is the parameter row at :15454 (ANGLE, bounds --, default 0.003906, unit degrees, precision --); Glow table :15438-15458, enumerations :15460-15470 (Glow Colors 2=A & B Colors, Color Looping options), A & B Midpoint row :15455; the SD-26 note :13833-13843; no clause describes how phase offsets the A & B colour cycle, and MT-32005 AC-011 is a bounds row. So no loop rotation was invented.
glow_phase_case.behaviour: a phase equal to the recorded default plus or minus whole turns (within 4 eps |phase|, at least 1e-9 degrees) is the default; any other phase stays a typed composition_effect_option refusal; the stored value is never wrapped; tests 725 renders like 5 and -30 evaluates are NOT applicable (they would need the unspecified semantics)
glow_phase_case.spec_gap_for_lead: Glow Color Phase semantics (what an angle does to the A & B colour cycle, its unit meaning and the periodicity) are missing from the spec; the default 0.003906 is unproven (SD-26), so the comparison point may be wrong
